metadata.description: Generic Claude Code plugins for AI engineering workflows. Sole plugin since v4.0.0: learn-kit — pedagogical kit covering manual 8-stage authoring methodology, AI three-tier learning doc generation with interactive HTML, and NotebookLM multimedia artifact generation (audio/video/slide_deck/infographic × 3 view variants + 1 shared mind_map = up to 13 artifacts per topic; markdown-only sources). Tested with mj-system and mj-agent.

plugins.name: learn-kit
plugins.description: Pedagogical kit for learnable knowledge artifacts. Five skills: (1) /learn-kit:init scaffolds the learning subsystem; (2) /learn-kit:locate reverse-looks up concepts; (3) /learn-kit:scan enumerates learnable docs; (4) /learn-kit:generate-tier AI-generates three-tier (foundation/structural/challenge) learning markdown plus optional interactive HTML; (5) /learn-kit:nlm-studio pushes a topic's three-tier markdown corpus to NotebookLM and generates up to 13 online-viewable multimedia artifacts (4 view-cycled types × 3 views + 1 shared mind_map; markdown-only sources). nlm-studio requires notebooklm-mcp MCP server (bundled) + nlm login; the other four skills run with no external dependencies.
